subject: English Home Language

source.topic: Wild animals and sport: Emergent Writing
source.subtopic: Letter formation of 'l' (finger paint, crayon, sand tray)

show.line: Let's write l. Start up high and go straight down, tall and thin. l, l, lion!

rounds.prompt: Tap the letter that says l, as in lion.
This letter says l. Say the sound!
Trace l with your finger. Start at the top and go straight down.
Look carefully. Which one is l? It is one tall line.

hints: l is one tall, straight line.
Start at the top. Go straight down.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write l for lion.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: A short line with a little bump. Look, I wrote l!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is r. l is one tall line.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Look together. Start up high and go straight down. That is l!

parent_line: Can recognise the letter l, say its sound and trace it.
